description:
With new LP ‘Break The Wall’ freshly issued on BBE Music, MF Robots unleash brand new remixes of single ‘Gold’ by UK production hero Atjazz and Houston beatmaking duo Beanz N Kornbread.

Martin Iveson, aka Atjazz, is simply a mainstay of the UK scene, bringing electronic, jazz and deep house fans together in praise of his unique production aesthetic. His ‘Soul Love’ remix of ‘Gold’ shimmers with dreamy keys and lush subtle atmospherics.

Fresh from reworking Sons Of The Sun’s ‘Underwater Dreaming’ for BBE Music, Donald Johnson & Kenneth Roy, aka Beanz N Kornbread, return to the label with a lo-fi, warm and soulful ‘Nawfside’ remix of ‘Gold’. The Texas duo have gained notoriety writing and producing for Z-Ro, Paul Wall, Mac Miller, George Clinton, Slim Thug, Le$ and Snoop Dogg, in between Johnson’s hectic tour schedule as drummer for Khruangbin.

About MF Robots:
Collaborating for the first time while recording and performing with one of the UK’s most commercially successful Acid Jazz bands The
Brand New Heavies in 2013, founder / drummer Jan Kincaid and vocalist Dawn Joseph discovered immediate musical chemistry and began writing songs together right away.

They soon left the band to concentrate on their own work, starting MF Robots (Music For Robots) and releasing an eponymous debut in 2018. The duo quickly morphed into a band as they found themselves in-demand at venues and festivals all over Europe, and haven’t
looked back since.
